purpose: Bridge the lifecycle and cascade state machines so a campaign cannot advance through contradictory policy, acceptance, or lineage snapshots.
rule: Both controllers must name the same campaign lineage, policy epoch/snapshot, complete acceptance contract, exact state identities, and an allowed stage pairing: BUILDING/FIRST_PASS_BUILDING, TERMINAL_PROPOSED/TERMINAL_PROPOSED, FIRST_PASS_REPAIR_REQUIRED/FIRST_PASS_REPAIR_REQUIRED, TERMINAL_SETTLED/TERMINAL_SETTLED, FINALIZER_ACTIVE/FINALIZING, FINALIZER_COMPLETE or DELTA_AUDIT/DELTA_REPAIR, and all lifecycle release or live-closure stages/READY_FOR_ACCEPTANCE. A transition that changes one side without the other or advances contradictory stages fails closed.
